context.transcript:
Hi, I'm in town for a convention and I have some questions about taking the train to the Beller Convention Center.
You can take the Orange Line south.
The convention center's the third stop.
Thanks.
I'm also confused by this self-service ticket machine.
I'm not sure which ticket to get.
I'm only going from my hotel to the conference center and only for a few days.
Oh, you probably won't need a weekly pass.
I'd suggest purchasing the book of ten tickets.
Great.
I'll get that one then.
Thanks.
You're welcome.
But you should know that this week routine maintenance is scheduled for that line, so the trains will stop running at 11 p.m.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，我来镇上参加一个大会，我想问一些关于怎么坐火车去Beller Convention Center的问题。
你可以乘坐Orange Line往南走。
会议中心是第三站。
谢谢。
我也对这个自助售票机感到困惑。
我不确定该买哪种票。
我只是从酒店到会展中心，而且只待几天。
哦，你可能不需要周票。
我建议购买一叠十张的票。
好的。
那我买那一种吧。
谢谢。
不客气。
但你应该知道，本周计划对这条线路进行例行维护，所以火车会在晚上11点停运。
